name: Touchline
author: Kristján Ingi
description: Your football team's next fixtures, latest result and live score in the bar

barWidget.description: Pick any club or national team. The next fixture sits in the bar, with the live score during a match; the popup has the latest result, recent form, a countdown and upcoming fixtures. Data from ESPN's public API (site.api.espn.com), every 30 minutes and every minute around kick-off; crests from a.espncdn.com.

schema.label: Show next opponent in the bar
schema.description: Off leaves just the ball; a live match still shows its score. On a vertical bar the label is a tooltip.

schema.label: Team
schema.description: Set by picking a team in the popup (click the team name to change it). This is the team's ESPN id, e.g. 359 for Arsenal.

schema.label: Refresh in the background
schema.description: Fetches from ESPN every 30 minutes, and every minute from 15 minutes before kick-off until the match ends. Off fetches only at startup, when you open the popup, and on middle click.
